name: Nine To Five

features.name: Wild variants
features.description: Wilds transform into types with different effects.

review:
Office satire on 5x4. xNudge wilds land on reels 2 to 5 and gain +1 per nudge, xWays reveal two to four symbols (all the same if several land), and regular wilds turn into variants like the Green Wild, which carries a random multiplier.

Rated Insane, but the 9,217x cap is unusually low for that rating. Office humour with Nolimit's usual edge.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
